ETA_AXIS_SERIALIZATION.derivation: conservative relative float64 coefficient/reader arithmetic bound on the axis unit-vector construction; NOT a fitted tolerance and NOT the 0.80 jackknife guardrail

cooptimal_gauge_lexicographic_tiebreak: encode +1->0, -1->1 over blocks sorted by ancestry id; pick the lexicographically smallest bitstring; reproducibility only, not a proof of gauge invariance
